title: Mixed Event — Time to RE:START! — Episode5 Dreams and Reality

meta.Event Outline: Eager to make MORE MORE JUMP! official, Airi and the others waste no time in searching for an agency to join, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Will I really have the chance to be an idol again?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No! I can't let myself think like that!
It'll only make me feel worse!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is exactly when I need to act more like an idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I need a song to pick me up...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is always my favorite group to listen to when I'm feeling down. Somehow, they always manage to put a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Idols sure are amazing...
Singing, dancing, making all those people smile...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
You've been watching this girl a lot lately.
Do you really like her that much?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! It's like just seeing her makes me happy. I can't help but start smiling.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Watching that idol shining on the TV like that always made me smile...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's the one who gave me the motivation to keep working hard day after day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's also the reason I wanted to become an idol too. I wanted to help spread those feelings to even more people.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is your SEKAI. Come back and visit any time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Especially if you're ever feeling down!
We'll make sure to cheer you right back up♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wonder if I'll get any ideas if I visit now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Airi!
You came to visit♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hi, Rin. It's been a while.
You're as energetic as ever.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I had a feeling you'd come to visit again soon! Does this mean we're all singing together again?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, but...? Where's everyone else? Are you alone?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Um, yeah...
It's just me today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... There's no point in trying to act tough.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Besides, you've already seen me at my worst.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're usually so full of energy, but I get worried about you when you look so upset.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're exaggerating.
It's not that serious...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's just... A lot happened recently.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't know what's troubling you, but I can see that it's something very important.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's easy!
I can see right through everything, you know!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whether it's about you, everyone else who isn't here today, the weather tomorrow, even what you're going to have for dinner! I can see it all!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're definitely making some of that up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But...
I do feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I have something to ask you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can you sing me a song you think will help put a big smile on my face?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, is that all? Coming right up!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I have just the song for such an occasion!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This one's sure to make you smile and bring back the happy, energetic Airi everyone loves!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, get ready to have some fun♪
